title: Classic Tomato Pasta
instructions: Boil pasta. Sauté garlic and onions in olive oil. Add canned tomatoes and simmer. Mix with pasta and top with basil.

title: Garlic Butter Chicken
instructions: Season chicken breast with salt and pepper. Sauté garlic in butter. Pan-sear chicken until golden brown and cooked through. Serve hot.

title: Simple Grilled Cheese
instructions: Spread butter on bread slices. Place cheese in between. Toast on a pan until bread is golden and cheese is melted.

title: Caprese Salad
instructions: Slice fresh tomatoes and mozzarella. Layer them with basil leaves. Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze.

title: Garlic Bread
instructions: Mix softened butter with minced garlic and parsley. Spread on sliced bread and bake until golden brown.

title: Tomato Basil Soup
instructions: Sauté onions and garlic in olive oil. Add canned tomatoes and vegetable broth. Simmer for 15 minutes and blend. Stir in fresh basil.

title: Creamy Garlic Mushroom Pasta
instructions: Boil pasta. Sauté mushrooms and garlic in butter. Pour in heavy cream and simmer. Toss with cooked pasta and parsley.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Sauté sliced onions in butter until deeply caramelized. Add garlic and beef broth. Simmer for 30 minutes. Top with toasted bread and melted cheese.

title: Classic Cheese Omelette
instructions: Whisk eggs with salt and pepper. Pour into a heated buttery pan. Add cheese in the middle and fold when cooked.

title: Lemon Herb Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken with lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, and parsley. Grill or pan-sear until fully cooked.

title: Boston Baked Beans
instructions: Soak navy beans overnight. Drain and place in bean pot with salt pork, molasses, brown sugar, mustard, and onion. Cover with hot water and bake slowly for 6 hours until tender and dark.

title: New England Clam Chowder
instructions: Dice salt pork and cook until crisp with minced onion. Add diced potatoes and clam liquor, simmering until soft. Stir in chopped clams, warm milk, cream, and butter.

title: Boston Brown Bread
instructions: Mix cornmeal, rye flour, and wheat flour with baking soda and salt. Stir in molasses and buttermilk until smooth. Pour into greased molds and steam for 3 hours.

title: Parker House Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm milk with sugar. Knead with flour, butter, and salt into soft dough. Let rise, roll flat, cut into rounds, crease in center, fold over, and bake until golden.

title: Classic New England Beef Stew
instructions: Dredge beef in flour and brown in butter. Add beef broth, onions, carrots, and potatoes. Simmer gently for 2 hours until beef is fork-tender.

title: Chicken a la King
instructions: Melt butter and cook mushrooms and bell peppers until tender. Stir in flour, chicken broth, and cream to form sauce. Fold in cooked chicken and pimentos.

title: Boston Macaroni and Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni until tender. Prepare a roux with butter and flour, whisk in warm milk until thickened, then melt in sharp cheddar cheese. Toss with macaroni and bake.

title: Cream of Tomato Soup
instructions: Simmer tomatoes with onion, sugar, and seasoning. In a separate saucepan, prepare a white sauce with butter, flour, and hot milk. Add a pinch of baking soda to tomato puree, then stir into white sauce.

title: Boston Corn Chowder
instructions: Fry salt pork until fat is rendered, then sauté sliced onion until tender. Add diced potatoes, sweet corn kernels, and boiling water. Simmer until potatoes are soft, then stir in milk and butter.

title: Old-Fashioned Apple Pie
instructions: Toss peeled sliced apples with sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, and lemon juice. Line pie tin with pastry, fill with apples, dot with butter, cover with top crust, and bake until golden.

title: Broiled Sirloin Steak
instructions: Wipe steak dry and season generously with salt and pepper. Broil on high heat turning once. Cream softened butter with lemon juice and finely minced parsley, spreading over the hot rested steak.

title: Traditional Shepherd's Pie
instructions: Sauté ground beef with onions, carrots, and peas in butter. Stir in flour and broth to create a rich gravy. Transfer to baking dish, spread mashed potatoes on top, and bake until golden.

title: Clam Fritters
instructions: Chop clams finely. Whisk flour, baking powder, salt, eggs, and milk into a thick batter. Fold in clams. Drop spoonfuls into hot oil and fry until crisp and puffed.

title: Maryland Fried Chicken
instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper, dredge in flour, dip in beaten egg, and coat in fine breadcrumbs. Pan-fry in butter and oil until golden brown, then make a pan milk gravy.

title: Classic Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Slice potatoes thinly. Arrange layers in buttered baking dish, sprinkling each layer with salt, pepper, flour, and dots of butter. Pour hot milk over potatoes until covered, and bake until tender.

title: Split Pea Soup
instructions: Soak dried split peas. Add to a pot with smoked ham, diced onions, and carrots. Simmer gently for 2 hours until peas break down into a thick, comforting soup.

title: Strawberry Shortcake
instructions: Bake rich sweet baking powder biscuits. Split warm biscuits in half, spread with softened butter, spoon sweetened crushed fresh strawberries over the bottom half, and top with whipped cream.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: Cook lemon juice, water, sugar, butter, and cornstarch until thick. Whisk in egg yolks and pour into baked pie crust. Whip egg whites with sugar to stiff peaks, spread on top, and bake until browned.
